rival_reading: A courier could follow an ordinary field-delivery schedule after hours; a gate-time rule and a receipt do not prove officials stranded anyone.
gloss: A courier credential makes transfer paperwork due after access has ended.
title: Mara Cardenas
body: Transfer receipt due after gate access ended. Courier route: field office to transfer window. Reverse: bring bread home for mother.

rival_reading: The late time may be a routine after-hours field delivery or a delayed ledger entry; the map and key tally do not establish a failed evacuation.
gloss: A courier's last route entry follows a closure time while a key count is complete.
title: Last run entered after closure
body: Mara's map marks the transfer gate beyond the work road. The last run is logged after the closure time; a child's drawing is in the fold, while the key count is signed.
